references.text: The original instruction for making braided chains of pure gold for the breastpiece, as Exodus 39:15 describes their execution.
Parallel text describing the braided chains of pure gold that were to be attached to the breastpiece.
The continuation describing how the braided gold chains were attached to the breastpiece and the ephod.
Instructions on how the braided gold chains were to be fastened to the rings of the breastpiece and the ephod.
This verse places the twisted chains in the broader context of the total execution and material use of the breastpiece.
This verse shows the practical function of the twisted chains: to bind the breastpiece firmly to the ephod so that it does not come loose.
